supersedes: L30 / a14_r7 thigh pin panel 60x70 front + 40x50 rear push-through (0.018 kg/leg)
basis: Legs L63-R (504082f): 8 x o7x10 42CrMo4 radial, H7/m6 bonded (638/648), rows z 8.25/25.75, row 2 at +45 deg
design: Removable 1.5 mm PC band segment of the P-020 thigh fairing, 50 mm tall centred on collar mid, 218 deg arc (az -64..154, 0=front, 90=outboard) at r~45; 8 mm lands, 6 x M3 captive quarter-turn. Removing it exposes every pin under the front+outboard arc with >= 40 mm radial line-of-sight and o15 tool envelope; rear pin via the kept 40x50 window (now open, no panel); inboard pins face the open inter-thigh zone. No push-through path needed (pins are single-wall, blind).
tool: M3 tapped extractor + slide hammer, radial; heat release (Loctite 638/648 release needs local heat ~250 C: band open gives hot-air nozzle line of sight); install with o6.5 drift

pins.access: inboard open zone (inter-thigh gap, no fairing)
